program_scope.canary_semantics: Affliction, actor 30008, Chainwielder, and Magmaw are evidence inputs only. The reviewed shared source-identity change contains no class, actor, encounter, instance, size, difficulty, geometry, or route-node branch.

independent_review.shared_predicate: Both production start-held and arm paths use BotControllerRouteHold::CompareSourceIdentity. It requires valid lower-hex exact equal 40-character configured/requested authorities and a valid lower-hex 12- or 40-character binary revision equal to the exact source prefix/full value.
independent_review.typed_evidence: Start-held/status exposes typed presence, format, equality, accepted, failure-field, and length values without adding the generated or requested raw authority. Arm returns distinct typed fixture, seal, source-authority, and Git-revision reasons.
transcript_audit: start-held receives the full source and acknowledges Held only after the shared predicate accepts the generated short revision
status serializes the full held scope and recomputes accepted config identity against GitRevision::GetHash
the controller compares two stable held identity projections before emitting one full-source arm command
the native arm GateInput receives full configured/requested source plus the canonical short GitRevision and uses the shared predicate
checkpoint reset preserves the moved controller hold; terminal observes exact current identity
release reconstructs current identity and replaces only command seal/source, so exact state identity remains required
ordinary route mutation remains suppressed before release and must advance exactly one generation afterward
